Track label with an optional second line

Source: R/seq_track_label.R
seq_track_label.Rd

Draws a text label beside a track's window area, vertically centred on the track, with an optional smaller second line beneath it. Useful for naming rows in multi-track figures (samples, haplotypes, assembled sequences) without relying on axis titles.

Usage

seq_track_label(
  label,
  sublabel = NULL,
  side = c("left", "right"),
  aesthetics = aes()
)

Arguments

label

Label text (a single string). NA or "" draws nothing.

sublabel

Optional second line (a single string). NULL or NA draws no second line.

side

"left" (default) places the label right-aligned just left of the window area; "right" places it left-aligned just right of it.

aesthetics

Optional SeqAes. Keys: size (cex, default 0.75), col (default "#1C1B1A"), offset (gap from the window area in lines, default 0.6), sublabel.size (default 0.65), sublabel.col (default "grey35"), sublabel.face (default "italic").

Value

A SeqTrackLabelR6 instance.

Examples

seq_track_label("sample 1", sublabel = "haplotype A")
